tls.note: HTTPS via box tailnet cert when present, plain HTTP otherwise (E085_TLS=0 forces plain).

fee_note: 5% platform fee on every order. Mock math until STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set; then Stripe Connect splits fee automatically.

checkout.mock: no key set: orders recorded with escrow math, no money moves
checkout.live: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY set: Connect split fee_bps to platform, net to seller
checkout.payouts: Connect Express onboarding + dashboard (needs-herald item: payouts)

model_blurbs.success_tip: Tiny base + tip when it wows
model_blurbs.stake_slash: Both sides stake, slash on miss

order_note: Buyer pays into escrow -> accepts result (seller paid net) or disputes (platform resolves: release|refund). Trial runs are free, capped, no payout.

inference.lanes: Zen default, Gemini Flash budget, Groq/Together-oss bulk, OpenRouter fallback. See data/inference.md.

auth.why: Shared Google OAuth dev keys = Google login with zero Google Cloud console work.

provisioning.domain_registrar: Porkbun (in-app RDAP check, manual buy; top pick data/domains.md: swarmly.cc)
provisioning.keys_note: All API keys from env, listed here, never in code.

sell_pitch: Sell the marketplace itself: point a buyer at / (hero + live orders + seller earnings), show fee math on any order, show data/pricing.md margins. Self-hostable: one Python file, stdlib only, SQLite-free JSONL store.

launch.how: 1 click = Stripe payment authorizing setup. Webhook funds the job, swarm fulfills: subdomain site, Clerk org, Resend sender, Connect account, delivery via accept/dispute. Custom domain = upgrade (registrar purchase). Owner step: buy sites domain (e.g. swarmly.cc) + wildcard DNS.
